verdict.rationale: Stable's core product is a physical-mail and registered-agent service: staffed locations scan, forward, shred and deposit mail, and it handles USPS Form 1583 onboarding and legal registered-agent addresses. Self-hosting is a category error for that kind of service, since a buyer could not run the core offering on their own infrastructure. Nothing in the evidence suggests any self-hostable distribution, so the axis does not apply.
